# Fixtures

Markdown files used by the round-trip tests in `tests/markdown/`.

- Put real notes here (5–10 is plenty). The core M1 guarantee is that each one survives
  open → save without unintended changes.
- If a file is intentionally normalized on save, commit the expected output next to it as
  `<name>.expected.md`.
- This README is ignored by the tests.
